statement: Never spawn a subprocess per row and never do O(all sessions/conversations) work uncached on a path that scans ~/.claude/projects or session state; gate by candidacy (recent-mtime window), cache by (mtime, size) persisted to disk, batch subprocess calls into one
rationale: Every "CCC is slow" incident traced back to the same bug pattern, invisible at test scale (tiny fixtures) but seconds-plus with 1000+ real transcripts. This is the general form of con_627861dec9; recording it broader since it also covers Ask-tab-style new retrieval paths (search_recent_sessions, search_conversation_history, search_local_automation_hits) that are exactly the kind of per-question filesystem/subprocess work this constraint exists to bound.
